map.：男性，腰围 95 cm、TG 2.0 mmol/L、HDL 0.9 mmol/: : male, waist 95 cm, TG 2.0 mmol/L, HDL 0.9 mmol/L, blood pressure 135/88 mmHg, fasting glucose 6.0 mmol/L: all 5 items met -> diagnosed as metabolic syndrome. The Chinese criteria usually use waist cutoffs of >= 90 cm for men and >= 85 cm for women.

map.ATP III 与中国标准差异？: Differences between ATP III and the Chinese criteria?
map.核心 5 项一致，腹型肥胖腰围切点不同（中国男≥90、女≥85 cm），且空腹血: The core 5 items are the same, but the waist cutoff for abdominal obesity differs (China: men >= 90, women >= 85 cm), and the fasting glucose cutoff is commonly >= 5.6 mmol/L; clinically follow domestic guidelines.
map.干预核心是什么？: What is the core of the intervention?
map.以生活方式干预为首：减重 5%–10%、规律有氧、改善饮食结构与控盐控糖；达标困: Lifestyle intervention comes first: lose 5%-10% of body weight, regular aerobic exercise, improve diet structure, and control salt and sugar; if targets are hard to reach, use medication per indication for each component.
